## Add Disclosure

`knowledge/AddDisclosure`

Share information with one or more characters from now on, as a
disclosure: they know the text, whether or not it comes from an entry.
Character Perspectives only; in Standard scenes use Grant Knowledge.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state (passthrough) |
| `text` | `str` | (optional) the information |
| `characters` | `list` | the character names |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state |
| `disclosure` | `dict` | the saved disclosure as a dict |

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `text` | `""` | The information to share |

## Character Knowledge

`knowledge/CharacterKnowledge`

Report one character's knowledge without an LLM request: grants with entry
labels and accessible restricted entries. Legacy
reports also include revokes; perception reports include disclosures.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `character` | `str,character` | character name or character |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `character` | `str` | the character name |
| `text` | `str` | the report |
| `grants` | `list` | the character's Learn edges as dicts |
| `revokes` | `list` | the character's Never Learn edges as dicts (Standard only) |
| `disclosures` | `list` | disclosures shared with the character as dicts (Character Perspectives only) |

## Character Knows Entry

`knowledge/CharacterKnowsEntry`

Whether a character knows an entry: a character sheet entry, a world entry
or a history entry, by the same rule that decides what reaches the
character's memories. Answers without an LLM request.

Reasons for not knowing: revoke (a Never Learn rule), visibility (the
entry's Known by leaves the character out) or presence (the character did
not witness the history entry).

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `character` | `str,character` | character name or character |
| `target` | `str` | (optional) entry id (or give context_id_item) |
| `context_id_item` | `context_id_item` | (optional) the entry as a Context ID item (or give target) |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `known` | `bool` | True when the character knows the entry |
| `reason` | `str` | why not, or None |
| `entry_id` | `str` | the id knowledge edges use for the entry |

## Entry Knowledge

`knowledge/EntryKnowledge`

Who knows a context entry: its Known by setting (or the presence of a
history entry) and the grant and revoke edges pointing at it.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `context_id_item` | `context_id_item` | the entry as a Context ID item |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `context_id_item` | `context_id_item` | the input, passed through |
| `entry_id` | `str` | the id knowledge edges use for the entry, or None |
| `text` | `str` | the Known by line, empty when the entry cannot be known or unknown |
| `visibility` | `dict` | the Known by setting as a dict, or None |
| `grants` | `list` | list of grant edge dicts |
| `revokes` | `list` | list of revoke edge dicts |

## Grant Knowledge

`knowledge/GrantKnowledge`

Establish selected information in perception mode, or a whole-entry edge in legacy mode.
Disclosures are acquired now without inventing dialogue; whole_entry explicitly copies all source text.
In legacy mode a grant does not lift an earlier Never Learn for the same entry unless
`replace` is on; the World Editor's Learn lifts it.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state (passthrough) |
| `character` | `str,character` | character name or character |
| `target` | `str` | (optional) existing entry id (or give context_id_item) |
| `context_id_item` | `context_id_item` | (optional) resolved source entry (or give target) |
| `note` | `str` | (optional) optional note on legacy edges |
| `information` | `str` | (optional) selected text; required for partial disclosures |
| `whole_entry` | `bool` | (optional) false by default; true copies all current source content |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state |
| `edge` | `dict` | legacy edge, or None in perception mode |
| `text` | `str` | disclosure result or the legacy Known by line |
| `disclosure` | `dict` | saved disclosure in perception mode |

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `note` | `str` | `""` | Optional note stored on the edge |
| `source` | `str` | `"granted"` | Where the edge comes from. Choices: `told`, `granted`, `inferred`, `manual`, `director`. |
| `replace` | `bool` | `False` | Keep one edge per character and entry: the new edge replaces an existing grant or revoke for the pair. Without it, an earlier Never Learn stays and still wins over a new grant |
| `whole_entry` | `bool` | `False` | True copies all source content, including private details; False discloses only the supplied information. |

## Grant Knowledge Confirmation

`knowledge/GrantKnowledgeConfirmation`

Format the director grant confirmation for the scene's knowledge mode.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `template` | `str` |  |
| `variables` | `dict` | (optional) |

This node supports **dynamic inputs** - additional input sockets can be added in the editor as needed, and connected values are collected with key inference (see [Collector Nodes](../../core-concepts/collector_nodes.md)).

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `result` | `str` |  |

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `template` | `text` | `""` | A format string with placeholders (e.g., "Hello, {name}") |
| `perception_template` | `text` | `""` | Disclosure confirmation used only when character perspectives are enabled. |

## Knowledge Callbacks

`knowledge/KnowledgeCallbacks`

Collect director knowledge callbacks, omitting revocation in perception scenes.

Legacy scenes retain all callbacks. Uses List Collector's dynamic inputs.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `list` | `list` | (optional) optional base list |

This node supports **dynamic inputs** - additional input sockets can be added in the editor as needed, and connected values are collected with key inference (see [Collector Nodes](../../core-concepts/collector_nodes.md)).

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `list` | `list` | available knowledge callbacks |

## Remove Knowledge Edge

`knowledge/RemoveKnowledgeEdge`

Remove Learn and Never Learn rules: one edge by its id, or every edge
between a character and an entry. What the character knows then follows
the entry's Known by setting again.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state (passthrough) |
| `edge_id` | `str` | (optional) the id of one edge (or give character and target) |
| `character` | `str,character` | (optional) character name or character |
| `target` | `str` | (optional) entry id |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state |
| `removed` | `list` | the removed edges as dicts |
| `text` | `str` | the entry's Known by line after the change |

## Revoke Knowledge

`knowledge/RevokeKnowledge`

Revoke a character's knowledge of an entry in legacy scenes.
Perception scenes reject this operation before mutation; no amnesia is provided.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state (passthrough) |
| `character` | `str,character` | character name or character |
| `target` | `str` | (optional) entry id (or give context_id_item) |
| `context_id_item` | `context_id_item` | (optional) the entry as a Context ID item (or give target) |
| `note` | `str` | (optional) optional note stored on the edge |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state |
| `edge` | `dict` | the stored edge |
| `text` | `str` | the entry's Known by line after the change |

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `note` | `str` | `""` | Optional note stored on the edge |
| `source` | `str` | `"granted"` | Where the edge comes from. Choices: `told`, `granted`, `inferred`, `manual`, `director`. |
| `replace` | `bool` | `False` | Keep one edge per character and entry: the new edge replaces an existing grant or revoke for the pair. Without it, an earlier Never Learn stays and still wins over a new grant |

## Set Entry Visibility

`knowledge/SetEntryVisibility`

Set the Known by setting of a character sheet entry (description,
attribute, detail) or a world entry.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state (passthrough) |
| `context_id_item` | `context_id_item` | the entry as a Context ID item |
| `mode` | `str` | everyone, owner or list (required) |
| `characters` | `list` | (optional) the character names for the list mode |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state |
| `entry_id` | `str` | the id knowledge edges use for the entry |
| `text` | `str` | the entry's Known by line after the change |

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `str` | `"everyone"` | Who knows the entry. Choices: `everyone`, `owner`, `list`. |

## Set Static History Known By

`knowledge/SetStaticHistoryKnownBy`

Set who knows a static history entry, in Standard knowledge scenes:
everyone, nobody, or the listed characters.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state (passthrough) |
| `context_id_item` | `context_id_item` | the static history entry as a Context ID item |
| `mode` | `str` | everyone, nobody or list (required) |
| `characters` | `list` | (optional) the character names for the list mode |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state |
| `entry_id` | `str` | the static history entry id |
| `present` | `list` | the characters who know it, or None for everyone |
| `text` | `str` | the entry's Known by line after the change |

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `str` | `"everyone"` | Who knows the entry. Choices: `everyone`, `nobody`, `list`. |
